subject: Re: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>; Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)

Thanks again for the demo earlier, Liam/Sofia — great conversation. Per our agreement on the call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration build milestone. High level summary below and next steps.

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones tab)

Key milestone: Integration build plan (owner assignments and target dates)
- SDK integration (client-side): Owner: Acme (Sofia) / Redwood support: Priyom Das (Solutions) — Target: 2027-06-15
- Real-time streaming (server-side): Owner: Redwood engineering (Neha) / Acme infra: Liam — Target: 2027-06-22
- Tool calling hooks (external tool invocation for workflows): Owner: Redwood (Priyom) / Acme product: Sofia — Target: 2027-06-29
- Structured outputs & schema (JSON schema, validation): Owner: Acme (Sofia) / Redwood (Rachel) — Target: 2027-06-29

Dependencies called out:
- Acme SSO / KMS proof-of-concept (procurement signoff) — impacts Private deployment timeline
- Network egress rules and IP allowlist from Acme infra team for streaming endpoints
- SDK telemetry + telemetry gating decision (minimal v1 vs v1.1)

Open asks / next steps:
1) Can Sofia confirm SDK owner and internal dev lead (name + weekly cadence)?
2) Liam — confirm networking/allowlist contact and any firewall window constraints by EOD Thu 5/6.
3) Redwood to share a short integration runbook and example streaming flow — I attached integration-milestones-v2.xlsx with an added runbook tab.

I'll update the MAP (Google Doc linked below) after you confirm owners and dates. If everything looks good we'll propose a kickoff week of 6/1 to start the joint sprint planning.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- SDK owner: confirmed — Sofia will own the SDK integration. Dev lead is Amir Shetty (amir.shetty@acme.com). Sofia, can you confirm weekly sync cadence?
- Networking: I'll loop in our infra lead (cc'd above in follow-up) but short answer: we need a 2-hour maintenance window to test allowlisting; prefer 6/20–6/25 window if possible.
- Tool calling: need to understand invocation auth flow (will Redwood sign requests on our behalf or do we expect Acme to provide a service token?).

I'll review the MAP in detail later today and propose edits.

— Liam
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp
liam.oconnor@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)

Appreciate the quick confirmations, Liam. A few answers and updates inline — I'm updating the MAP and will push a v2 by EOD.

- Sofia / Amir: noted — Sofia please confirm weekly sync (preferred: Tuesdays 11am PT) and add Amir to the MAP owners column.
- Networking window: 6/20–6/25 is fine for Redwood. We will schedule a 2-hr testing window and provide the allowlist IPs and connection checklist one week prior.
- Tool calling auth: Redwood can support two models 
  1) Redwood-managed service token: Redwood signs tool invocation requests on behalf of Acme (requires contract addendum and token exchange flow)
  2) Customer-supplied token: Acme supplies a service token that Redwood will pass through at invocation time (preferred for compliance).

Priyom — can you draft the short runbook + example for the tool calling auth options and attach to MAP v2?
Neha/Rachel — please confirm Redwood engineering owners for streaming and structured outputs testing.

Ben — recommend we hold a commercial checkpoint once owners/dates are locked (I think 6/1 kickoff is still OK if we lock owners by 5/10).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)

Adding the runbook stub and auth matrix here — I'll attach a fuller doc to the MAP v2.

Attachment: integration-milestones-v2.xlsx (runbook tab added)

Runbook (summary)
- SDK integration: sample snippet for JS/Go/Python, expected handshake (API key + optional PKCE for client flows)
- Streaming: sample WebSocket and HTTP streaming examples; recommended max chunk size and retry logic
- Tool calling auth options:
  * Redwood-managed token: Redwood rotates token, signs calls, provides audit logs (requires POA/contract extra)
  * Customer-supplied token: Acme stores token in KMS and returns short-lived token to Redwood at runtime
- Structured outputs: canonical JSON schema v0.1 included (fields: action_type, payload, confidence_score)

I'll be available for a short call Friday 5/7 to walk through the runbook if that helps.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.com>

Subject: Re: MAP draft — Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools, structured outputs)

Thanks all — quick confirmations from Acme: 
- I confirm ownership of SDK integration and will add Amir Shetty to the MAP owners column. Weekly sync Tuesdays 11am PT works.
- We prefer customer-supplied token for tool calling (compliance preference).
- Networking: Liam will share the infra contact; we can target the allowlist test during 6/20–6/25 as discussed.

We'll review the MAP v2 once you push it and aim to lock owners/dates by 5/10. If so, kickoff during the week of 6/1 still looks realistic for joint sprint planning.

Sofia Martinez
Product Lead, Integrations
Acme Corp
